title: Throwable Slimeballs
description: Adds throwable bouncing slimeballs, new slime-based effects, and a new brewable potion.
body:
Throwable Slimeballs

Throwable Slimeballs gives slimeballs a new and useful purpose in Minecraft.

With this mod, vanilla slimeballs can be thrown like projectiles. They can damage enemies, knock them back, apply a custom Slimed effect, bounce off blocks, damage the Ender Dragon, and even destroy End Crystals.

Features

Throw slimeballs by right-clicking

Slimeballs bounce off blocks

Slimeballs can break on ground bounce with a 12.5% chance

Deals 1 heart of damage on hit

Knocks back mobs and players

Applies the custom Slimed effect

Slimed slightly slows targets and shows green particles

Damages the Ender Dragon

Destroys End Crystals

Adds a new Bouncy Potion

Adds Bouncy Potion II

Adds long, splash, and lingering Bouncy Potion variants

Bouncy effect lets players and mobs bounce after falling

Sneaking disables the Bouncy landing bounce, similar to slime blocks

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer

Bouncy Potion

The Bouncy Potion can be brewed using slimeballs and gives players or mobs a slime-like bouncing effect when they land after falling.

Potion variants include:

Potion of Bouncy

Long Potion of Bouncy

Potion of Bouncy II

Splash Potion of Bouncy

Lingering Potion of Bouncy

Compatibility

Minecraft 1.21.1

Fabric Loader

Java 21

Client and Server

Throwable Slimeballs is a lightweight vanilla-friendly mod that makes slimeballs more fun, useful, and chaotic without changing the core Minecraft experience.
